claim: 'python -m aero_kernel.importer.rule_table --check' (a CI gate) may exit 0 on a stale or missing rule_table.json; the writing branch is not executed by any test.
evidence: assert main([str(DRELA), "--check"]) == 0  -- the only call of main; mutation 'return 1' -> 'return 0' in the stale branch: 74 passed.
recommended_test: Fast, test_evaluation_rules.py: monkeypatch aero_kernel.importer.rule_table.rules_module.__file__ (or Path resolution) to a tmp directory. (1) main([DRELA]) == 0 and tmp/rule_table.json == render_rule_table(load_rule_table(DRELA)). (2) main([DRELA, '--check']) == 0. (3) overwrite the file with '{}' -> main([DRELA, '--check']) == 1 and stdout contains 'rule_table.json is stale'. (4) delete it -> == 1.

claim: A quantity the kernel returned with status error or skipped can be reported as not_applicable ('The kernel found it not applicable: no reason given') instead of not_available, and no test fails. The consumer then reads a failed computation as 'the rule does not apply to this aircraft'.
evidence: if quantity.status is not QuantityStatus.OK: return _verdict(rule, RuleStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE, f"`{slug}` has no value (status {quantity.status.value}).")  -- no test builds a QuantityResult with status ERROR or SKIPPED; evaluation_builders.py offers only ok, spread, not_applicable, not_given.
recommended_test: Fast, test_evaluation_evaluator.py. Add builders errored(slug) (QuantityResult status ERROR with a KernelError) and skipped(slug) (status SKIPPED with its Reason). For each: judge(result_of(x)) must have status RuleStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE, value None, severity None, and 'status error' resp. 'status skipped' in verdict.explanation; and caplog on logger aero_kernel.evaluation must stay empty.

claim: No evaluator test places a value or an interval end exactly on a band edge; the edge behaviour is pinned only one layer down in Band.position. A change in how the evaluator hands ends to the band (e.g. rounding the value as it does for the text, `:.4g`) would pass.
evidence: assert judge(result_of(spread(SM, -0.1, 0.0))).status is RuleStatus.BELOW   -- the nearest case; every interval in the file keeps both ends clear of 0.05 and 0.15.
recommended_test: Fast, test_evaluation_evaluator.py, band 0.05..0.15 inclusive: ok(SM, 0.05) and ok(SM, 0.15) -> INSIDE, severity None; spread(SM, 0.05, 0.15) -> INSIDE; spread(SM, 0.05, 0.1500001) -> PARTLY with only the above meaning; ok(SM, 0.04999999) -> BELOW (shows no rounding to 4 digits before judging). With min_inclusive False: spread(SM, 0.05, 0.10) -> PARTLY.
